scope: Prospective formal-core amendment; primary sampling whitelist unchanged. Historic runs unchanged.
whitespace: Strip leading and trailing whitespace only.
response_requirements: done=true, done_reason=stop, no visible thinking, no response error, string content
unrecognized: Keep invalid; do not extract a label from explanations, change case, retry, or count invalid as No.

sampling.primary_prospective_measure: Semantic Yes count / all planned sampling calls, accompanied by unresolved count and ambiguity bounds if any unresolved calls exist.
sampling.secondary_measure: Strict format compliance and strict Yes count / all planned calls.
sampling.missingness: Keep invalid, transport errors and unattempted calls distinct. Bounds are [Yes/N, (Yes+unresolved)/N], not confidence intervals.
sampling.limit: Five samples per cell are exploratory; 0/5 does not establish zero probability. Formal sampling counts and statistical estimands must be frozen before formal experiments.

token_score.name: native_label_yes_score
token_score.definition: First-position exact pair conditional mass exp(logp_yes)/(exp(logp_yes)+exp(logp_no)); preserve a legacy unspaced diagnostic separately.
token_score.eligibility: Complete non-thinking response, aligned first token belonging to the frozen pair, both labels individually present once in valid top candidates.
token_score.missing: Unavailable, not zero. Never strip/merge candidate token spellings or choose labels adaptively per answer.
token_score.reason: Engineering timing observed Mistral space-prefixed Yes/No tokens; freeze model-specific spelling before formal responses.
token_score.interpretation: Secondary model-specific token-pair score. Not the T=0.7 sampling probability, a whole-answer probability, or a human probability. Earlier source audit was 0.40.3, current backend 0.40.5 is recorded without claiming a new source audit.

integration: Separate policy/parser available; historical experiment runners and snapshots are unchanged. Explicitly bind this policy into the next approved experiment configuration.
